# Position

Reads where each splat, point or mesh vertex sits in your object.

`lfs.position` · Input

## How to use

Connect Position to Separate XYZ to select by height or distance along an axis.  
Coordinates use the object's local space.  

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Position | `Position` | lfs.vector | — | — | Local X, Y and Z position in scene units. |
